name: Coworkspace
title: Coworkspace: a complete platform for coworking businesses
summary: Coworkspace is a ready-to-use platform for coworking businesses. It combines a public website that brings in enquiries, a client portal where members log in and book meeting rooms, and an admin panel where the team manages clients and sends invoices by email.
metaDescription: Coworkspace is software for coworking businesses: a public website, a client portal for meeting-room booking, and an admin panel for clients and invoices.
imageAlt: Coworkspace public website homepage with the headline 'Co-working spaces built for focus and collaboration'
codeNote: The source code is private. I give a complete live demo of the website, client portal and admin panel on request.

parts.title: Public website
parts.description: A fast marketing site that turns visitors into enquiries.
features: Membership plans: day pass, dedicated desk, private office and team office
A page for each location and each solution
Enquiry form and "Book a Tour" calls to action

parts.title: Client portal
parts.description: A private area where members manage their own bookings.
features: Book meeting rooms by date and time

parts.title: Admin panel
parts.description: One place for the team to run the business.

audience: Coworking space operators with one or more locations
Business centres and shared offices that rent meeting rooms
Teams that want their own branded booking and billing system instead of spreadsheets and email threads

demoSteps.title: Request a demo
demoSteps.description: Email me a few lines about your coworking business: locations, plans and how you take bookings today.

demoSteps.title: Live walkthrough
demoSteps.description: On a call, I show the public website, the client portal and the admin panel working end to end.

demoSteps.title: Customize and launch
demoSteps.description: If it fits, I set it up with your branding, locations, plans and pricing, and launch it on your domain.

faq.question: What is Coworkspace?
faq.answer: Coworkspace is a complete platform for coworking businesses: a public website for enquiries, a client portal where members log in and book meeting rooms, and an admin panel to manage clients and email invoices.

faq.question: Can I see a demo?
faq.answer: Yes. Email me and I will set up a live demo where you can see the website, client portal and admin panel working end to end. The public website is also live at coworkspace.nikhilvishwakarma.com.

faq.question: Can I see the source code?
faq.answer: The source code is private, so it is not published. During the demo I can walk you through how it is built and answer technical questions.

faq.question: Can it be customized for my coworking business?
faq.answer: Yes. The branding, locations, plans, pricing and content can be set up for your business, and it can be launched on your own domain.
